pages.text: $(lilomon)$(#503a30)Even if we chose to share, i noticed how he eyed the Ring with a glimmer. The envy and the silence, that comes with his gaze, brother worries me to full extent...
$(lilomon)$(#503a30)Day by day, he stare each day, smiling less and less when we once cared. i thought time would help me and him to grow, sometimes nothing can be wrong to do too..
